status: Source-only continuity/streaming feasibility review, no acoustic or model experiment
confirmed: Each app pass allocates a fresh TdtDecoderState, retaining no linguistic context across frozen segments
SDK single-window public transcribe accepts caller state, uses isLastChunk true, and returns token timings
SDK TdtDecoderState holds reference-backed MLMultiArray hidden/cell states; its explicit deep-copy initializer is internal. A plain Swift value copy does not independently snapshot those arrays
SDK public SlidingWindowAsrManager retains decoder/token/timestamp context with overlapping windows; default geometry has11s chunk,2s left,2s right. Adopting that default would postpone first output
The app usesv3/int8/CPU+NeuralEngine. Its per-pass<=14.5s segments bypass SDK long-form overlap/merge protections; a backlog>15s can instead invoke that SDK path
The SDK documents multilingual prior drift, final quiet-window blanking and a carried-state blank trap; no naive persistence or overlap-text dedup is accepted
